_source: Human-readable names given in the Day 3 notebook (sections 12-13) after reading each cluster's centroid. They belong to the committed K = 4 model (StandardScaler + KMeans, random_state=42, n_init=10). `customers` is a consistency check: if the notebook is re-run and a cluster's size changes, the API ignores that name and falls back to 'Cluster <id>'.

clusters.name: Low-Value Occasional Buyers
clusters.description: Rare, small, cheap orders; lean towards Books, Beauty and Food; long time since the last order.

clusters.name: Big-Basket Buyers
clusters.description: Infrequent but the largest orders; lean towards Electronics and Home & Garden; almost no discounts.

clusters.name: Discount-Driven Shoppers
clusters.description: Mid-sized orders at by far the highest discount rate; broad category mix.

clusters.name: Loyal Frequent Buyers
clusters.description: About 2.5x more orders than other groups, the most recent purchases and the highest total spend.
